title: William Wing Loring
description: William Wing Loring (1818-1886) was a career military officer who fought in the Florida Seminole Wars, the Mexican American War, the Civil War, and the Egyptian Ethiopian War. He lost his left arm in a battle during the Mexican American War, and subsequently posed with his left sleeve pinned to his chest. He was a commanding Confederate General. During his service to the Khedive, an occupation that lasted ten years from 1869 to 1879, Loring was charged with maintaining Egypt's coastal defenses at Alexandria and Rosetta as Inspector General. Loring was granted the title of Fereek Pasha for his role commanding troops in the Egyptian-Ethiopian War (1874-1876).
